integrity: Proof is analytic; exact rational finite tests are consistency checks, not a substitute for infinite proofs. General Nyström and pivot concepts are cited as prior art, not claimed new. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One unweighted combinatorial-Laplacian star family, exactly one unrescaled Nyström column, trace/nuclear error, and fixed-positive-time large-size asymptotics; does not assert a bound for multiple sampled columns, an arbitrary low-rank optimum, or relative trace-error regret.
title: Sharp heat-kernel Nyström landmark transition and vanishing success of diagonal sampling on stars
